title: Mandrake Handshake performs "Hypersonic Super Asterid" & more Live on KEXP from Trans Musicales

author: KEXP
description:
http://KEXP.ORG presents Mandrake Handshake performing live at ESMA in Rennes, France, during Trans Musicales 2025. Recorded December 4, 2025. 

Songs:
King Cnut 00:01
Lorenzo's Desk 04:53
The Change And The Changing 08:54
Hypersonic Super-Asterid 14:13

Row Janjuah - Guitar, Vocals
Max Goodall - Guitar
Trinity De Simone - Vocals
Rudy Symonds - Vocals
Elvis Thirlwell - Percussion, KORG, Vocals
Joe Bourdier - Drums
Jake Kavanagh - Bass
Shan Sriharan - Synth

Host: Morgan
Audio & Mastering Engineer: Matt Ogaz

Cameras: Jim Beckmann, Carlos Cruz, Scott Holpainen & Luke Knecht
Editor: Luke Knecht
